pages.text: When two Domains overlap, a $(bold)Domain Clash$() begins:$(li)the barrier in the overlapping region disappears and both Domains' effects are suspended$(li)Cursed Energy drain intensifies: × (1 + (the opponent's Cursed Output + their Cursed Affinity/10)/100)$(li)the loser is forcibly pulled into the winner's Domain and the barrier is rebuilt$(br2)Cursed Energy is drained continuously — whoever runs out first loses.
